senses: 1) treasurer of king Cyrus of Persia
2) a Persian officer stationed at Samaria in the time of Artaxerxes
1) son of Hashum who took and put away his foreign wife in the time of Ezra

H4993.def: Mattithjah, the name of four Israelites
senses: 1) a Levite who presided over the offerings
2) a Levite appointed by David to minister in the musical service before the ark
3) one of the family of Nebo who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
4) one of the men who stood at the right hand of Ezra when he read the law to the people
H4993.deriv: or מַתִּתְיָהוּ; from {H4991} and {H3050}; gift of Jah;

H4994.def: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
H4994.deriv: a primitive particle of incitement and entreaty, which may usually be rendered;
H4994.kjv: I beseech (pray) thee (you), go to, now, oh.

H4995.deriv: apparently from {H5106} in the sense of harshness from refusal;

H4996.def: No (i.e. Thebes), the capital of Upper Egypt
senses: 1) the ancient capital of Egypt; also 'Thebes'

H4997.deriv: or נאוֹד; also (feminine) נֹאדָה; from an unused root of uncertain signification;

H4998.def: properly, to be at home, i.e. (by implication) to be pleasant (or suitable), i.e. beautiful
senses: 1) to be comely, be beautiful, be befitting
1) pasture, abode, abode of shepherd, habitation, meadow
